item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"sequence_modeling","rationale":"Halve the configured context length, rounding up, to reduce stale-interest interference and recurrent computation across all four datasets. Existing truncation retains recent interactions chronologically, and checkpoint metadata applies the same length during prediction. Preserve the GRU, embeddings, readout, loss, optimizer, and routing.","edits":[{"find":"MAXLEN        = int(os.environ.get(\"GRU4REC_MAXLEN\", \"128\"))","replace":"MAXLEN        = max(1, (int(os.environ.get(\"GRU4REC_MAXLEN\", \"128\")) + 1) // 2)"}]}],"change_summary":"Reduce default context from 128 to 64; halve configured overrides with upward rounding. Training, validation, and the generated predictor share the shortened context through existing metadata."}
